title: Free generation services without an API key
summary:
Free generation services need no API key, model routing and image-response handling got attention, and two community chat apps joined the project list.

Enter added a registry for text and image generation services. Registered free services can now be called without an API key; generation requests also get usage-based price calculation and more consistent tracking.

Gemini Search requests now use the Vertex model ID needed to route correctly. Nano Banana gained a request timeout and clearer handling when a response is safety-blocked or contains no image data, alongside moderation tracking. The Azure-backed gptimage registry entry was removed.

The Chat Projects list added Strapick Chat, a minimal chat UI, and LLMS, a Kotlin Multiplatform app for text chat and image generation across Android, iOS, desktop, and WebAssembly.

daily.title: Free services, no key
daily.text: Call registered free text and image generation services without an API key. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
